description: Google Ads lookup for a company domain from the public Ads Transparency Center: advertiser status, estimated ad count and up to 40 ads with format, dates and links; optional region filter. Use when an agent researches a company's or a competitor's advertising. No private account access. $0.01; no ads found is free.
